title: Footprint (one line)
description: State (footprints.jsonl): the source files a run of a probe executed, the compile-time paths and the toolchain, each with its id. The last line per probe wins.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version. A file or line without it is version 1 (the Python baseline).

footprint.description: Axis name to value, both compared ordinally.

watched.description: The paths the probe's registry entry watches, each with its object id at the commit the run built (null where it does not exist). A footprint line without one of the entry's watched paths is not current.

toolchain.description: Axis name to value, both compared ordinally.
